 Love in Disguise: All 12 Episode Release Dates and Finale
 Six episodes are listed on Prime Video. See when the remaining Love in Disguise episodes are scheduled to air.
 By Jeff Souza • @sitepapodedorama @sitepapodedorama • Published on 08.11.2026 at 07:47 • Updated on 09.11.2026 at 14:41

 Love in Disguise has 12 episodes, with two new episodes scheduled each week and the finale expected on November 24, 2026. Starring Im Si-wan and Seol In-ah, the Korean drama premiered on October 19. As of November 9, the first seven episodes are available on Prime Video, with Episode 7 released on Monday, November 9. Episode 8 is scheduled to air in South Korea on Tuesday, November 10.

 These are Korean broadcast dates. International viewers should check their local Prime Video listings, since the streaming release time may differ from the television broadcast.
 When does Love in Disguise end?
 The Love in Disguise finale, Episode 12, is expected to air on Tuesday, November 24, 2026. If the schedule remains unchanged, the drama will complete its 12-episode run over six weeks.
 The final two episodes are scheduled for November 23 and 24. The international streaming release should be checked separately on Prime Video.
 What is Love in Disguise about, and who is in the cast?
 Seol In-ah plays Kang Jae-hee, a police officer who disguises herself as a man to work as secretary to Yoon Yi-jun, played by Im Si-wan. The wealthy heir is under investigation following the death of his former secretary, and Jae-hee must search for evidence without revealing her true identity.
 The cast also includes Kim Jung-hyun as lawyer Kim Si-hyun and Yeonwoo as Lee Hye-jung, the chairman’s secretary. For more on the characters and the murder investigation, our Love in Disguise cast and story guide covers the drama without revealing its ending.
 Kim Jung-hyun and Yeonwoo play Kim Si-hyun and Lee Hye-jung, two characters connected to Yi-jun’s family business. Credit/source: tvN. Where can you watch Love in Disguise?
 Love in Disguise is streaming on Prime Video , with 7 episodes listed as of November 9. The platform offers English audio and subtitles among its language options, although availability can vary by region.
 If you’re deciding whether to start the drama, our Episode 1 review explores the dynamic between Yi-jun and Jae-hee and how their conflicting personalities shape the premiere.
